landing.title: One content in. Many channel-ready formats out.
landing.subtitle: ContentFlow AI turns a text or a transcript into a library of materials adapted to each channel, and tells you exactly what was processed for real and what is a template-based suggestion.
landing.honest: No generative AI is called by default. Outputs are labeled "template" or, in the future, "AI". Audio and video are not processed on our servers.
landing.limitsLink: Read what the product does not do

project.sourceHint: Paste text or open a .txt, .md, .docx, .pdf, .csv or .json file. Files are read in your browser; only the extracted text is stored (the file itself is not uploaded).

tr.title: Transcription
tr.hint: Paste a transcript, import a .srt/.vtt file, or (optional, experimental) transcribe an audio file in your browser. The server never transcribes anything; it only stores the text you approve.
tr.audioLocal: MP3, WAV, M4A or OGG. The audio stays on your computer: it is only used by the player below and by the optional in-browser mode. It is never uploaded.
tr.audioError: This browser cannot play this audio file.
tr.wasmExperimental: Experimental. It may fail or be slow, and it is never required.
tr.wasmReqDownload: Downloads a speech model to your browser the first time (about 40–80 MB, from Hugging Face).
tr.wasmReqRam: Needs about 4 GB of free memory; works best on a desktop with a stable connection.
tr.wasmReqTime: It can take 1–3 times the audio length, and the tab must stay open.
tr.wasmReqQuality: Small model: quality is low, especially for Portuguese and Spanish. Always review the text.
tr.wasmPrivacy: Your audio is processed locally; only the text you approve is sent to the server.
tr.wasmEstimate: Rough estimate for this file: download {{dl}} MB (first time), {{t1}}–{{t2}} min.
tr.wasmNeedAudio: Choose an audio file above first.

clips.heading: Clip suggestions
clips.disclaimer: Suggestions come from a text heuristic over your transcript timestamps: topic shifts, pauses, questions, imperatives, numbers, quotes and keywords. It does not analyze audio or video, and it does not detect emotion, facial expression or viral potential. Read each reason and decide for yourself.
clips.needTimestamps: Clip suggestions need a transcript with timestamps (import a .srt/.vtt or use the browser mode).
clips.none: No clear signals were found in this transcript. You can still add clips by hand.
clips.title: Title
clips.invalidRange: Use m:ss times, with the end after the start, and a title.
